      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/rpc/blockchain.cpp to acquire cs_main in blockheaderToJSON and getchaintxstats.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.3,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "The change fixes a data race where getblockheader and getchaintxstats read CBlockIndex fields without holding cs_main. While acquiring cs_main fixes undefined behavior reproduced under TSan, it introduces minor lock contention and addresses an edge-case concurrency issue in RPC endpoints."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Annotates CBlockIndex fields in src/chain.h with GUARDED_BY(cs_main) and fixes racy reads in validation and snapshot paths.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "It fixes confirmed data races on CBlockIndex::nTx and m_chain_tx_count during background validation and block processing. Resolving data races identified under ThreadSanitizer improves chainstate concurrency safety, though the issue does not threaten consensus validity or cause crashes."
    }
